title: Seconds to a clock
description:
Turn seconds into a clock and back.

```
3725 -> 01:02:05
01:02:05 -> 3725
99:99:99 -> not a time
```
hints: An `Option<u32>` is either `Some(value)` or `None`: end with `Some(h * 3600 + m * 60 + s)`, and `return None;` when a check fails. `let h: u32 = parts[0].parse().ok()?;` reads a number: `.ok()` turns the parse `Result` into an `Option`, and the `?` returns `None` from the function when the parse fails.
requirements: `fn from_clock(text: &str) -> Option<u32>` that refuses minutes or seconds of 60 or more and anything that is not three numbers.
